items.title: Strategy: bitcoin held vs its average purchase cost
items.description: Strategy's bitcoin holdings and its average purchase cost per BTC against the bitcoin price, weekly since August 2020. In the latest data (Oct 30, 2026) Strategy held 848,500 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, with bitcoin at $77,191.
items.reason: Bitcoin fell to about $57,500 this morning, well below Strategy's $75,446 average cost, and MSTR dropped about 8% ahead of its Nov 30 MSCI index removal. This shows how far underwater the stack now is.

items.title: S&P 500 P/E: trailing vs Shiller CAPE
items.description: S&P 500 trailing P/E and Shiller CAPE, monthly since 1950. As of Nov 20, 2026 the trailing P/E was 23.6 and the CAPE 36.4, down from 26.2 and 40.6 in October; the CAPE peaked at 44.2 in December 1999.
items.reason: The Nasdaq fell about 4% and the S&P 500 about 3% this morning on the AI selloff, a hotter core PCE print and new tariff proposals. This shows how much the correction has already taken off valuations and how rich they still are.

items.title: Free cash flow ($bn) — 2026–2030 estimates
items.description: Annual free cash flow of Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft and Amazon from 2006 with estimates for 2026–2030. Alphabet goes from $73.3bn in 2025 to an estimated –$77.1bn in 2027, Amazon from $7.7bn to –$74.3bn and Meta from $46.1bn to –$50.5bn, while Microsoft stays positive at $32bn.
items.reason: Nvidia sank more than 8% and Micron and AMD more than 9% this morning as doubts about returns on AI spending resurfaced. This is the cash cost of that spending at the hyperscalers.

items.title: SpaceX capex by segment (USD bn): the AI build-out dwarfs rockets and Starlink
items.description: SpaceX capital spending by segment. AI (xAI, X) capex reached $44.6bn in the four quarters to Sep 30, 2026, against $5.5bn for Starlink and $4.8bn for the launch business; AI capex was $12.7bn in 2025 and $0.5bn in 2023.
items.reason: The FCC authorized SpaceX this morning to deploy up to 1 million satellites as orbital data centers, while SPCX fell about 8% early on Tesla merger dilution worries. This shows how much of SpaceX's spending is already going to AI.

items.title: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions: 1.74M, up 67% in a year (Q3 2026)
items.description: Tesla's active Full Self-Driving subscriptions by quarter: 1.74 million in Q3 2026, up from 1.04 million in Q3 2025 (+67%) and 0.95 million in Q2 2025.
items.reason: Tesla fell more than 5% today after Reuters reported the EU pushed back its vote on Tesla's self-driving system from Dec 1. Europe-wide approval is the next leg for this subscription base.
